plan.why: Uptrend, and price has pulled back to its 20 day average. This is where trend buyers usually step in. Warning: this coin moves about 11% a day, so the stop is far away and the position must be very small. Many traders simply skip coins this wild.
plan.tested: Tested on the last 2.7 years of these coins: dip buys like this won 60% of the time but broke even on average, because the losses were bigger than the wins. Treat the zone as a better price, not an edge. Breakout signals tested better.
plan.profit_plan: Sell about a third at each target. After target 1, move your stop to your entry price so the rest cannot turn into a loss. If price closes a day below the 20 day average before the targets, sell the rest: that exit beat fixed holding in the backtest.
plan.cancel: Plan is wrong if price closes below 0.0416511. Sell there, no exceptions.

Buying after the break above the base was worse still. Catching bottoms has no edge in this data.
